head_height.value: 36 mm minimum head height; top of head at minimum 6 mm from top of photo

clothing_restriction.value: Wear normal daily clothing; no uniforms, costumes, or official attire

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, both eyes open

glasses_policy.value: Glasses not allowed unless for documented medical reasons

ears_visibility.value: Accessories must not cover any part of face or ears

face_visibility.value: Face must be fully visible and centered; face should take up 60-80% of photo

headwear_policy.value: Hats, headsets, or accessories not allowed; religious headwear permitted if full face and ears remain visible

accessories.value: No accessories that cover any part of face or ears
